How do I find a good UPVC spray painter?

The most important part of finding the right UPVC spray painter is getting multiple quotes. You need to find a few different quotes and see how similar the price is. If they are all in the same ballpark you can be confident you aren’t under or overpaying. This ensures that the tradesperson knows how much the work costs and what they are doing.
